title: internal/herd/wirevocab tests fail on this host: the installed herdr is newer than the pinned wire vocabulary
body: TestLiveVocabularyMatchesContract and TestLiveAgentKindsMatchContract fail at the base commit ce48c94 with my changes stashed: live herdr answers pane.link.resolve / pane_link_resolved and the agent kind 'letta', which internal/herd/wirevocab/herd-vocabulary.json does not carry. The host's herdr binary moved ahead of the recorded vocabulary, so every full-suite run on this machine is red at this package regardless of the code under test. Not touched by tick 19l; needs a deliberate vocabulary bump (the test's own message names the mechanism).
